answer_1.quote: We attempt to mitigate the hallucination and omission in LLM-based MT to improve its practicality in this work. ... We construct preference datasets by collecting translations using multiple MT tools and selecting the preference pair with a higher coverage score output by a word aligner.

answer_2.quote: Improving the BLEU and COMET score does not necessarily mean reducing hallucination and omission because there are other factors such as mistranslation and fluency.

answer_3.quote: We use one of the most powerful LLM, gpt-4-0613 , as an evaluator. LLM is prompted to check whether the given translation has hallucination or omission referring to the given source texts.
methods: prompted evaluation of hallucination/omission with coverage score

answer_4.quote: Three volunteers who speak Chinese and English are asked to assess the quality of the translation and the degree of hallucination and omission for the baseline and our model, without knowing which model generates the translations.
answer_4.guideline: Assess translation quality and the degree of hallucination and omission.
